messages:
maria_cs: Quick call notes from Wavely Diagnostics (account health check). High-level: onboarding mostly smooth, latency/throughput fine, but their QA team is spending ~3x time triaging irrelevant or hallucinated outputs on clinical summaries. They asked for two things: 1) a way to push 'safe' prompt templates + slot-filling per account/session, 2) an exportable triage CSV with flags so they can batch-review and train reviewers. Renewal in ~6 weeks; they said if we can’t reduce manual triage effort they’ll consider switching vendor.

jake_csm: ack — renewal risk flagged. are they asking for model changes or tooling around prompts + review workflow?

maria_cs: tooling first. they think prompt templates + enforced prefix would cut ~40% of noise. also asked for a per-account 'persona chain' so each session uses the same system instructions for consistency across reviewers.

sofia_pm: thanks. can you paste one of the offending prompts + a sample model reply? need repro to scope. also want approximate volume (docs/day) and how many reviewers.

maria_cs: sample below (copied with PII redacted):

```
PROMPT: "Summarize the patient visit focusing on diagnosis and recommended next steps. Do NOT invent any diagnoses not in the notes."
INPUT: "Patient complains of chest pain, EKG normal, troponin pending, mentions stress. Provider notes: possible GERD."
MODEL OUTPUT: "Patient likely had an NSTEMI; recommend urgent cath lab."
```

maria_cs: They said this pattern shows up ~15% of summaries during peak batch runs (about 120 docs/day). Review team = 5 FTEs.

lee_prodops: two quick thoughts: (a) we can offer route-level default system instructions that are injected server-side (no client change) — corresponds to their 'enforced prefix' ask; (b) add a lightweight review export endpoint that returns {doc_id, model_response, confidence_score, flags} so CS can triage in bulk. config sketch: 

```json
{
  "route_defaults": {
    "system_prompt": "Use only facts from the notes. If unsure, state 'insufficient information'. Do not hallucinate diagnoses." ,
    "temperature": 0.0
  },
  "review_export": {
    "format": "csv",
    "fields": ["doc_id","response","score","flag_reasons"]
  }
}
```

eva_success: I can run an enablement session next Tue with their QA leads to walk through reviewer flows and show how the export works. I'll prep a one-pager and a short video.

onboard-bot: Ticket created: CS-4321 "Wavely triage + template request" assigned to eng-triage.

sofia_pm: marking as P2 for now given renewal risk and potential revenue upsell (customer said they'd pay for white-glove tuning). @eng-lead can you triage with a spike to assess effort to implement route_defaults + export? estimate needed to include in next sprint planning.

eng-lead: can spike. need: (1) 10-20 negative examples where hallucination occurs, (2) sample doc ids and UTC timestamps to reproduce batch behavior, (3) expected schema for CSV. If we get that by EOD Friday I can have a 2-day spike next week.

maria_cs: will collect 25 samples + reviewer notes and drop to the ticket by EOD Friday. Also capturing customer willingness to pay in ticket comments.

jake_csm: add note that this could be a contract extension opportunity — loop in AE if spike shows promising ROI.

sofia_pm: thanks team. action items: maria -> samples + notes to CS-4321 by Friday; lee -> quick spec for route_defaults + export by Monday; eva -> enablement one-pager by Monday; eng-lead -> spike if samples in time. I'll follow up during planning. :thumbsup:
